premises.text: Loyalty punch cards and check-in apps are high-friction and unpersonalized for customers
premises.evidence_span: A lot of work for me as the customer. I gotta punch, I gotta check in, scan QR codes

premises.text: Top customers drive disproportionate revenue while most patrons are under-activated
premises.evidence_span: 85% of their customers are not meeting their maximum potential

premises.text: Linking credit cards awards points on normal swipes with zero merchant hardware or software integration
premises.evidence_span: there is zero software integration, zero hardware integration for the business. Cardify just works

premises.text: Businesses can offer spend- and identity-based VIP rewards, competitions, and redemptions in-app
premises.evidence_span: custom-tailored towards you based on how much you spend, what you're interested in, and who you are

premises.text: Real-time in-store identity, social context, spend history, and bottom-line insights act as local CRM
premises.evidence_span: surface up ton of data about those people

premises.text: Citigrid Media and Urban Spoon partnerships reach roughly half a million US merchants
premises.evidence_span: Cardify has a partnership with Citigrid Media and with Urban Spoon

value.text: Personalized VIP perks without loyalty busywork at checkout
value.evidence_span: I simply do what I normally do. I pay. And I instantly get points in Cardify

secondary_value.text: Local businesses recognize and engage customers in real time
secondary_value.evidence_span: show Fig & Olive who is at their store right now

causal_links.evidence_span: There's got to be a better way
half a million merchants across the US
